Container.Name: port-light
Container.Overview: Port occupancy map for a Docker host. Shows host listeners and container mappings in a traffic-light grid. Compose scanning is optional. Can pull occupancy JSON from other Port-Light instances. Includes a CLI and MCP server for port checks and reservations.
Container.Requires: Requires a writable appdata directory and access to the host Docker socket and /proc. Authentication is off by default; use a trusted network. See the ReadMe to enable Basic Auth or optional Compose scanning.

Config.Name: Compose stacks
Config.Description: Optional folder of Compose projects (read-only). Leave empty if unused. After mapping a folder, enable Compose in Port-Light Settings - Machines & scanning.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Docker API socket; a read-only mount does not restrict Docker API permissions

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Settings, reservations, manual entries, CLI credentials, and SQLite history

Config.Name: Enabled scanners
Config.Description: Default sources: listen,docker. Add compose only after mapping Compose stacks. Saved scanner choices in Port-Light Settings take precedence.

Config.Name: HIDDEN_UNLOCK_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Optional password to reveal hidden ports in the API

Config.Name: AGENT_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional token required for allocation and recovery requests

Config.Name: THEME_PALETTE
Config.Description: Optional named palette (gruvbox, catppuccin, nord, …); empty uses the built-in colors

Config.Name: LOCALE
Config.Description: auto, en, fr, de, es, zh-CN, zh-TW, or ja
